title: Drip, Drip, Drip: What Is Behind Your Sink Leak?
description: That persistent dripping sound from your faucet is more than just annoying; it can waste hundreds of gallons of water over time. A leaking tap usually stems from a few common issues. Worn-out O-rings or degraded rubber washers are the most frequent culprits, losing their seal due to regular wear and tear. Corrosion inside the valve seat or mineral buildup from hard water can also prevent the mechanism from closing completely. While replacing a basic washer might seem straightforward, incorrect assembly can cause hidden pipe damage. If your tap continues to drip, having a qualified plumber inspect the internal components will ensure a lasting fix.
